rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE (already fixed before this iteration): Previously the income-statement endpoint included period_close journal entries in revenue/expense aggregation. The period_close JE debits the revenue accounts (to zero them) and credits expense+retained-earnings — so revenue debit-credit-net became -35,691 (negative) and expense net became -1,836 (negative), giving a fake-negative net income display. FIX (verified in this iteration): routes_finance.py income_statement now filters out source='period_close' before aggregating, restoring proper positive accounting numbers. VERIFICATION: Backend pytest test_income_statement_all_time_positive + test_income_statement_last_30d_positive both PASS with revenue=35,791, expenses=1,836, net=33,955. Frontend visual confirmation on /accounting/comprehensive shows the same positive values on Net Income / Revenue / Expenses cards.
